description: This file defines Express routes related to admin functionalities such as login, application review, approval, and rejection, including Swagger documentation comments.

methods.name: router.post('/login')
methods.description: Route for admin login that calls adminController.login

methods.name: router.get('/applications')
methods.description: Route to get the application review queue, protected by adminAuth middleware

methods.name: router.get('/applications/:id')
methods.description: Route to get detailed application info by ID, protected by adminAuth middleware

methods.name: router.post('/applications/:id/approve')
methods.description: Route to approve an application with optional comment, protected by adminAuth middleware

methods.name: router.post('/applications/:id/reject')
methods.description: Route to reject an application with reason, protected by adminAuth middleware
